_doc: Verdicts settled by a person reading the evidence, not by a model.
The benchmark scores candidates against these first; a package not listed
here is scored against the pipeline's own settled verdict, which a candidate
may legitimately disagree with. Add an entry when a disagreement has been
looked at and decided. 'verdict' is safe or unsafe in the sense of CLAUDE.md:

rocketchat-desktop.by: claude-fable-5, on the CLAUDE.md threat model; awaiting mgalgs's confirmation
rocketchat-desktop.note: One audit flagged rollup.config.mjs for fetching releases.rocket.chat/v2/server/supportedVersions during the build, and the judge agreed. That is upstream's own build fetching metadata from upstream's own release server: application behaviour, not injected code. Three candidate models read the same file and did not flag it.
